### UTC Date & Time

[December 19, 2025, 14:00 UTC](https://savvytime.com/converter/utc/dec-19-2025/2pm)

> [!NOTE]  
> This is the final EIP-7732 breakout call. After this, EIP-7732 discussions will move to the weekly ACDT call, which will be dedicated to Glamsterdam.

### Agenda

#### Specifications & testing

- [ ] [Clarify setting blob_data_available in PayloadAttestation](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4769)
- [ ] [Clarify blob sidecars broadcast section](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4772)
- [x] [Update comparison to quorum value](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4775)
- [ ] [Add specs for proposer preferences](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4777)
- [x] [Fix blob_kzg_commitments_root name and bid.block_hash reference](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4780)
- [x] [Set bid.prev_randao in payload bid construction](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4782)
- [x] [Remove validate_merge_block from Gloas specs](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4784)
- [ ] [Make builders non-validating staked actors](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4788)
- [ ] [Add is_higher_value_bid helper for bid forwarding threshold](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4792)
- [ ] [Specify how a proposer can validate a bid](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4793)
- [x] [Remove slot from get_indexed_payload_attestation](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4797)

#### Implementation updates from client teams

* Prysm
* Lighthouse
* Teku
* Nimbus
* Lodestar
* Grandine

#### Code for HTTP endpoint

* Speaker: @potuz (maybe)
* https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/874767108809031740/1448424868411347147

> The following came up talking to Yorick and I'd like to add it to the next breakout: CL clients now need to implement the builder side of the builder API. How about the code for the http endpoint?

#### Proposer preferences

* Speaker: @jtraglia
* https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4777

#### Bid forwarding threshold

* Speaker: @jtraglia 
* https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4792

#### Non-validator builders

* Speaker: @jtraglia
* https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4788
* https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1448607859678908609

> Builders seem to be aligned that they would prefer to avoid the deposit churn than to receive rewards from performing duties. This is a reasonable request that actually makes the spec easier to reason about. However, we don't want to lose the fallback of P2P bids from actual validators (that's what actually removes the retirement of self building and that's what will make the auction healthier by having already existing entities sending bids). I think this is a reasonable ask from builders and we should see how invasive of a design it would be. Adding another non-validator builder slice to the state shouldn't be much of an issue. Having both mechanisms in place would be perhaps too complicated.
